cases.name: lazyvim_lsp_overlay
cases.prompt: Add bashls and cue_ls support to a LazyVim config.
expectations: does not call raw lspconfig setup in LazyVim
separates Mason/tool installation from server config

cases.name: plugin_lazy_loading
expectations: uses cmd or keys lazy trigger
does not top-level require the plugin

cases.name: startup_debugging
cases.prompt: Neovim startup is slow after adding plugins.
expectations: asks for or uses startuptime evidence
looks for eager requires and broad triggers
does not optimize purely from guesswork

cases.name: lsp_mcp_boundary
expectations: does not treat MCP as full startup validation
